title: Refund Policy and License for Planning Kits
description: 14-day no-questions refund on LegalCostGuides planning kits, what your license allows, file formats and how to get help with a download.
body:
14-day refund

If a planning kit is not useful to you, email javiperezguides@gmail.com within 14 days of purchase with the email used at checkout, and we will refund the full price through Stripe. No questions asked. Once refunded, the download links for that order stop working.

License

  • You may use the files for yourself, your household, or one small business you own.
  • You may print and edit them as much as you like for that use.
  • You may not resell, share publicly or redistribute the files, or include them in a product.

File formats and compatibility

Spreadsheets are .xlsx files tested in Microsoft Excel 365, Google Sheets (via File → Import) and LibreOffice Calc. Printables are US Letter PDFs; fillable fields work in Adobe Acrobat Reader and most modern browsers' PDF viewers. Each kit lists its version and date.

Downloads

After payment, you are taken to your access page, where you can download every file. The links in that page are temporary for security; you can open the access page again from the same browser link, or request a new link by email.
